page.layout: One column of verse, set full width in the centre of the page. Below it, centred, the gathering signature. Handwritten page number at top right and show-through from the reverse side are not transcribed. No margin notes.

main_text.p: Iustus vbi arma dolor vos iusta capessere coget. Est Casimirus auus, duris & auunculus armis Nobilis Albertus, magnos bellator in hostes Fortis, at haud nimium (sic sunt mortalia) felix. Est abauus vobis quoque nomine clarus eodem, Brandenburgiacæ decus & noua gloria gentis, Quo se olim forti Germania fortis alumno Extulit ante alias gentes, virtute manuq; Qui sibi Teutonici peperit cognomen Achillis. Heroäsq; alios, bellorum atque artibus almæ Pacis honoratos, maternum ortumq; paternum Quò longa gnati serie referatis, habetis, Quos omnes magno vox debilitata dolore, Et siccæ fauces, gelidæq; potentia mortis Iam me iamq; premens, & frigore membra resoluens, Enumerare vetat, verbisq; ornare disertis, Ipsorum quantum virtus æterna meretur.

Horum igitur fortes animos, patriaq; iuuandæ Egregium studium factis superate decoris. Sin minus hoc liceat, saltem exæquate sequendo. Et pia ni blando matrem spes fallit amore, (Sed, scio, non fallet matrem) virtutis auitæ Indignos nunquam hos iuuenes Friderice videbis.
Non etenim trepidas aquilæ generare columbas, Nec timidum poterit ceruum, segnemue iuuencum, Magnanimum invicti robur proferre leonis.
Nec dilecte mihi coniux, hanc fortibus ortam Atq; bonis prolem maioribus, arguet vllus Unquam degeneres & auitæ laudis egentes.

page.notes: The handwritten "162" at top right is not printed and is left out. Faint ghost text on the right margin and a faint "Expe-" at lower left are show-through from the other side and are left out. The verse paragraph breaks are inferred from indents and short line endings. Printed signature "c iij" at the foot is given in bottom_margin's place but omitted from the element list because it is a gathering mark only: c iij.
